summary.content:
Today's selection covers 98 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 68 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Shadowy AI Relay Disables OpenAI Codex, Claude Code Sandboxes
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Anthropic is asking Wall Street to believe in AGI
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 60 articles published in the last 24 hours
